note: The role-noun vocabulary for the CANDIDATES role-word guard — the payload declares the guard (role_word_rules_from_profile; profile rules DR-08/DR-09: role nouns are not identities and resolve to their defining named entities within each document). The words are the normalized forms (lowercase, whitespace-collapsed — the guard compares norm_ws surfaces) of the role nouns the payload's rule prose names: Company, Consultant, Employer, Executive, Service Provider, Service Recipient, Party, Parties, Party A, Party B, Affiliate. Until run 7 this set was a literal in core proposer code (finding A2-F2); it is domain content and lives here as pack data, consumed via pipeline.profile_config.pack_role_words / the resolved config's role_words key. Guard behavior is byte-identical to the core-literal era (run-7 golden tests, tests/test_role_words.py).
